verdict.rationale: SumUp exposes broad API/SDK coverage for checkouts, refunds, terminal payments, readers, and even an MCP server plus agent toolkit that let AI agents act via APIs (sumup-docs-11,12,13,17,25,26). However, some business-console features like customer rewards, automated marketing, and promotions (sumup-docs-19,34) appear only as UI/plan features with no documented API equivalents, and no public OpenAPI spec was found (sumup-probe-2), suggesting API coverage is not fully comprehensive parity with the UI.
